integrity: Proof is self-contained; the embedded exact-arithmetic checker independently corroborates finite part profiles, not all parameters; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite complete multipartite shortest-path metrics and the all-scales Gaussian-kernel criterion; does not classify a single fixed kernel scale beyond the universal exponent. Mathematical originality is subject to possible equivalent older truncated-metric graph spectral theorems; the Deza–Maehara paper was not available for full-text inspection.
title: Sharp positive-definite Gaussian exponent thresholds on arbitrary complete multipartite path metrics
